description:
My library is not being seen by pmda anymore after switching workflows. How can my scan find 4 albums (I got way more by the way) but yet have nothing in the library? 

I am not sure what I am doing wrong. I initially had the workflow as just look. never touch, then switched to build the shelf by moving files. Now all the music I had already organised by PMDA in /data/media/music is not being recognised. /data/media/music  is my NAS path, which is being mounted on NUC as /mnt/nas/data/media/music  Also, PMDA cannot see the library anymore? 

This setup worked flawlessly for the longest part.

Here are the folder permissions:

XXX@XXX:~$ sudo ls -l /mnt/nas/data/media
total 60
[...]
drwxrwxr-x 1 userXXX   65538 47114 Aug 23 14:41 music
drwxrwxrwx 1    1037   65538   110 Aug 20 20:57 music_dupes
drwxrwxrwx 1 root    root      202 Sep 10 23:18 music_incoming
drwxrwxrwx 1    1026 users     702 Aug 21 20:16 music_incomplete
drwxrwxrwx 1 root    root        0 Aug  3 23:48 pmda_export
drwxrwxr-x 1 userXXX   65538     0 Sep 10 17:52 pmda_trash
